more_info.overview: Nisin is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include other creams, unripened cheese excluding products falling in category 16, ripened cheese, processed cheese. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Produced by fermentation with Lactococcus lactis strains. Nisin is a mixture of closely related antimicrobial peptides.
